stemMd: A project uses 40 bolts. Large packs contain 12 bolts and small packs contain 5. What is the fewest total packs needed to obtain at least 40 bolts?
explanationMd: Three packs can hold at most 3×12=36 bolts, so at least four packs are required. Four large packs provide forty-eight bolts, satisfying the at-least requirement. Thus four is both feasible and minimal.

distractorRationale.a: Even three large packs contain only thirty-six bolts.
distractorRationale.c: Four large packs already supply enough bolts.
distractorRationale.d: This is more packs than necessary.
distractorRationale.e: This uses only small packs and ignores a smaller pack count.
